title: Armstrong's Spacecraft Once Spun Around Every Second

scenes.text: Neil Armstrong's spacecraft started spinning once every second.
It happened on Gemini 8, 27 minutes after the first docking in space.
A thruster had short-circuited and kept firing.
He undocked, but the spin got even faster.
Armstrong shut down the faulty system and used the re-entry thrusters to stop the spin.
The crew survived. Three years later, Armstrong walked on the Moon.

description:
Neil Armstrong's Gemini 8 spacecraft spun at nearly one turn per second after a thruster short-circuited and stuck open.
He stopped the spin with the re-entry thrusters, and the mission had to end after about ten hours.
Could you stay calm in that seat? Comment below.
first_comment: Armstrong saved the crew, then walked on the Moon. Is he the calmest person in history?
